business_rules.label: Order Status Retrieval
business_rules.description: Retrieves the current status of an order by order_id. If no matching order exists, the function explicitly returns NULL. The cursor OPEN/FETCH/CLOSE mechanics are infrastructure; the business logic is the lookup and its null fallback.

fallback.label: Missing Order Status Default
fallback.description: NULL returned when no order matches the supplied order_id; the %NOTFOUND branch explicitly assigns NULL rather than relying on uninitialised variable behaviour

actions.description: Return the retrieved order status, or NULL if the order was not found
